script_parts.opening: Namaskar, G. S. Marbles ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Mujhe aapka account dekh ke ek concern hua — pichhle 30 dinon mein aapka platform par zero active days hain, aur 4 buyer inquiries hain jo abhi tak unanswered hain. Yeh leads wait kar rahi hain, isliye aapko directly call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — kya koi specific wajah hai ki aap platform login nahi kar pa rahe? Matlab koi technical issue hai, ya business mein itna busy hain ki time nahi mil raha, ya phir leads ki quality se koi disappointment tha pehle?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 57 hai, jo 60 ke threshold se neeche hai, iska matlab aapki listing search results mein peers se peeche dikh rahi hai. Upar se Jaipur marble market abhi Red demand tier mein hai, toh jo bhi limited buyers aa rahe hain, unhe aapka catalog strong dikhna chahiye — warna wo competitor ke paas chale jaate hain.
script_parts.action: Chaliye abhi is call par ek kaam karte hain — main aapko aapki top product listing open karwata hoon aur ek saath CQS improve karne ke liye 2-3 missing fields — jaise product images, minimum order quantity, aur pricing range — fill karte hain. Sirf 5 minute lagenge aur score turant upar jayega.
script_parts.close: Bhai, aaj ke liye bas itna kaafi hai — agar aap hafte mein sirf 2 baar, 10-10 minute platform check karein aur in 4 unanswered BLs ko reply karein, toh hum agle call mein actual improvement dekh sakte hain. Kya yeh aapko manageable lagta hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, G. S. Marbles ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. While reviewing your account, I noticed something concerning — you've had zero active days on the platform in the last 30 days, and there are 4 buyer inquiries sitting completely unanswered. Those leads are waiting, which is why I wanted to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly, bhai — is there a specific reason you haven't been able to log in recently? Is it a technical issue, are you too busy with business operations, or was there some disappointment with lead quality earlier that put you off the platform?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's something important — your CQS score is currently 57, which is below the 60 threshold, meaning your listings are ranking lower in search results compared to other sellers. On top of that, the Jaipur marble market is currently in the Red demand tier, which means buyer volume is already limited — so the few buyers who are searching need to see a strong catalog from you, otherwise they simply move to a competitor.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing together right now on this call — I'll walk you through opening your top product listing, and we'll fill in 2-3 missing fields together, such as product images, minimum order quantity, and price range. It'll take just 5 minutes and your CQS score will move up immediately.
script_parts_en.close: Bhai, that's all I'm asking for today — if you can check the platform just twice a week for 10 minutes each, and reply to those 4 unanswered BLs this week, we can track real improvement on our next call. Does that feel manageable for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
